summary: New Found Gold Corp., a Canadian gold miner listed on TSX and NYSE-American, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 15, 2026, reporting preliminary third-quarter 2026 operational results following the achievement of commercial production at its 100%-owned Hammerdown Gold Mine on August 19, 2026. Q3 production totaled 4,863 ounces of gold on 6,035 ounces sold at an average realized price of US$4,310/oz ($6,033/oz), with 85% recovery. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated; this is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
